cases.notes: VIP Prime customer via ClearFeed Slack. On hold pending carrier investigation.

cases.title: T-Mobile SMS Blocking - Service Not Available
cases.findings: T-Mobile users can't text customer's numbers - receiving 'Sorry, this service is not available' error. T-Mobile network-level blocking (MO messages rejected before reaching Telnyx).
cases.notes: Ongoing T-Mobile carrier issue. Escalated to Syniverse.
cases.response: Escalated to Syniverse for T-Mobile network-level blocking investigation.

cases.title: SMS Deliverability - Messages Not Received
cases.findings: SMS to patients not received but shows as delivered in logs. Investigation ongoing.
cases.notes: High priority. Customer reports incorrect delivery status in SMS logs.

cases.title: Call Bridge Failures
cases.findings: Call bridging operation failures. JIRA escalated.
cases.notes: VIP customer. Multiple call control IDs provided. JIRA escalation in progress.

cases.title: SIP 503 Analysis - Offshore Calls
cases.findings: 25% of offshore calls receiving 503 response. Multiple toll-free numbers affected. JIRA escalated.
cases.notes: VIP customer provided extensive call control IDs. WebRTC call events not visible via API.
cases.response: Analyzing 503 patterns and media stream disruptions.

cases.title: Philippines SMART Network - EDGE Only
cases.findings: Users in Philippines limited to EDGE instead of 4G/5G on SMART networks. IMSI 311210394334361 affected.
cases.notes: Internal escalation from Wireless team. Complex investigation.

cases.title: SIM Cards Not Connecting
cases.findings: 3 SIM cards not connecting or dropping connection. Waiting for ICCIDs from customer.
cases.notes: Self-service customer. Urgent priority. Complex investigation pending customer info.

cases.title: Big Jitter - Telnyx to AudioCodes
cases.findings: 290ms jitter from Telnyx peers to AudioCodes SBC. Two call samples provided with high jitter on RTP streams.
cases.notes: VIP customer. JIRA escalated. Media quality investigation.
cases.response: Investigating RTP jitter between Telnyx and AudioCodes.
